dialogues.info: Char: narrator | Voice: default_narrator_001 | [0]: Sound door_knock
dialogues.source: Pacifica arrives at Gideon’s house. She knocks on the door.[0]
dialogues.target: Pacifica arrives at Gideon’s house. She knocks on the door.[0]

dialogues.source: Gideon! It’s Pacifica! The girl you met yesterday, remember? I got your address from sooS!
dialogues.target: Gideon! It’s Pacifica! The girl you met yesterday, remember? I got your address from sooS!

dialogues.source: Abruptly, the door swings open with a distressed Gideon standing in the doorway.
dialogues.target: Abruptly, the door swings open with a distressed Gideon standing in the doorway.

dialogues.source: Pacifica! <size=120%>Shhh!
dialogues.target: Pacifica! <size=120%>Shhh!

dialogues.source: Oh, hey Gideon! What’s up? You answered the door fast! Usually it takes me a whole minute to get to it…
dialogues.target: Oh, hey Gideon! What’s up? You answered the door fast! Usually it takes me a whole minute to get to it…

dialogues.source: Pacifica, please just go before-
dialogues.target: Pacifica, please just go before-

dialogues.source: BOY!!!
dialogues.target: BOY!!!

dialogues.source: WHO IS AT THE DOOR THIS EARLY IN THE MORNING? IT BETTER NOT BE THE POLICE!
dialogues.target: WHO IS AT THE DOOR THIS EARLY IN THE MORNING? IT BETTER NOT BE THE POLICE!

dialogues.source: Gideon, is that your dad?
dialogues.target: Gideon, is that your dad?

dialogues.source: Yes, but no need to-
dialogues.target: Yes, but no need to-

dialogues.source: HELLO SIR, I AM JUST PICKING GIDEON UP FOR THE DAY!
dialogues.target: HELLO SIR, I AM JUST PICKING GIDEON UP FOR THE DAY!

dialogues.source: IS THAT A GIRL’S VOICE?!
dialogues.target: IS THAT A GIRL’S VOICE?!

dialogues.source: On second thought, I’ll come with you as long as it’s far, far away and we don’t come back for at least a couple hours.
dialogues.target: On second thought, I’ll come with you as long as it’s far, far away and we don’t come back for at least a couple hours.

dialogues.source: Sure! I’ll take you someplace that’ll blow your mind…
dialogues.target: Sure! I’ll take you someplace that’ll blow your mind…

dialogues.source: Yeah, whatever. Let’s just get out of here first.
dialogues.target: Yeah, whatever. Let’s just get out of here first.

dialogues.source: Sooo… Your dad seemed like a really nice guy! Why did we have to leave so fast?
dialogues.target: Sooo… Your dad seemed like a really nice guy! Why did we have to leave so fast?

dialogues.source: Ah… He just gets a little weird about… surprise guests. You should call before you come over next time.
dialogues.target: Ah… He just gets a little weird about… surprise guests. You should call before you come over next time.

dialogues.source: Oh…
dialogues.target: Oh…

dialogues.source: Ahem… So where are we going?
dialogues.target: Ahem… So where are we going?

dialogues.source: Please don’t tell me you just found some rare bird’s nest or something weird…
dialogues.target: Please don’t tell me you just found some rare bird’s nest or something weird…

dialogues.source: Pfft! Who do you think I am? No, no. I have something far better.
dialogues.target: Pfft! Who do you think I am? No, no. I have something far better.

dialogues.source: I’m getting worried…
dialogues.target: I’m getting worried…

dialogues.source: Did you eat breakfast?
dialogues.target: Did you eat breakfast?

dialogues.source: Of course not! It’s really early!
dialogues.target: Of course not! It’s really early!

dialogues.source: It’s actually only 10 am… But your answer was perfect!
dialogues.target: It’s actually only 10 am… But your answer was perfect!

dialogues.source: Wait a minute… Are you taking me out for breakfast?
dialogues.target: Wait a minute… Are you taking me out for breakfast?

dialogues.source: Hehe, yep! And here we are!
dialogues.target: Hehe, yep! And here we are!

dialogues.source: By the way, did you know that this place has the most amazing pancakes...?
dialogues.target: By the way, did you know that this place has the most amazing pancakes...?

dialogues.source: Melting chocolate chip bliss with a fresh drop of whipped cream and juicy cherry on top...
dialogues.target: Melting chocolate chip bliss with a fresh drop of whipped cream and juicy cherry on top...
